eslint.config.mjs: The lint rules themselves. eslint loads this, and the `lint` step in .github/workflows/js-unit-suite.yml is the gate on it.
tools/lissajous_page.js: tools/lissajous.html's entry module. Importing it builds the page: it calls bootstrapTool() at the top level, which stands up a WebGL scene the fake DOM cannot provide. Its math is tests/lissajous_math.test.js's subject, its rational lock is scripts/lissajous-probe.mjs's, and the rest of the page only the load smoke in scripts/browser-smoke.mjs.
tools/mobius_page.js: tools/mobius.html's entry module. Importing it builds a WebGL scene at the top level; its transforms are covered by tests/mobius_transforms.test.js, its complex-plane pads by scripts/mobius-probe.mjs, and the rest of the page only by the load smoke in scripts/browser-smoke.mjs.
tools/palettes_page.js: tools/palettes.html's entry module. Importing it binds the page DOM at the top level; its math and controls are covered by their unit tests, its strip-zoom and hue-key-wheel pointer handlers by scripts/palettes-probe.mjs, and the rest of the page only by the load smoke in scripts/browser-smoke.mjs.
tools/solids_page.js: tools/solids.html's entry module. Importing it builds a WebGL scene and loads the WASM engine at the top level; its helpers are covered by their unit tests, its op-chain reorder by scripts/solids-probe.mjs, and the rest of the page only by the load smoke in scripts/browser-smoke.mjs.
main.js: index.html's entry module, whose body is `void bootstrap()`. Importing it starts the simulator, which is why bootstrap.js stays separately importable and tests/bootstrap.test.js covers it there.
vendor-importmap.js: An IIFE the page loads by script tag, not a module. tests/vendor-importmap.test.js evaluates its source in a node:vm sandbox, which is not a module load.
scripts/browser-smoke.mjs: Drives headless Chrome over every manifest-served page. The reusable browser workflow runs it, and there is no part of it a unit test could reach without a browser.
scripts/generate-shader-v2-documents.mjs: Regenerates the committed v2 pattern documents and digest_migration.v1v2.json from the v1 fixtures on import, so a test load would rewrite the working tree. Its output is what tests/shader_document.test.js pins: the byte-identical re-export gate and the migration-table completeness case fail if the committed files drift from what a rerun would write.
scripts/run-tests.mjs: tests/run_tests.test.js drives it as a subprocess against a fixture repo, so the loader resolves the fixture invocation rather than this path.
scripts/record-module-loads.mjs: Loaded through NODE_OPTIONS before its own loader hook exists; a missing recorder leaves source modules uncovered and fails the roster gate.
